from pathlib import Path
finding = json.loads(Path('.exp_agent/findings_round_02.json').read_text())
report = json.loads(Path('.exp_agent/round_completion_02.json').read_text())

print('reported locations:', [(x['relative_path'], loc['line'], loc['column'], x['rule']) for x in report['entity_repairs'] for loc in x['locations']])
print('status:', [x['status'] for x in report['entity_repairs']])
PY"
